hypothesis.claim: The exact already-running orphaned Endpoint428 parent process can be observed without control or scientific inspection and will leave an immutable 10,364,777,488-byte CMX21P1 trace plus a nonempty archive whose frozen pretrace inputs remain byte-identical, thereby authorizing one zero-credit immutable-trace analysis continuation while preserving continuous-resource-proof=false.
hypothesis.falsification: Forbid analysis from this artifact set if adopted process identity changes, a frozen pretrace input changes, the terminal trace has the wrong byte count/header/row count, the archive is empty, source-v1 is mutated by the observer, or scientific values are accessed before both adopted processes are absent.

changedMechanism: Add only a forward, read-only adoption observer and terminal immutable-artifact sealer around the already-running orphaned v1 wrapper/CMIX process; do not change v1 execution, probabilities, files, process state, or scientific predicates.
invariants: The observer binds boot ID, PID, Linux process start ticks, parent relation, and raw argv SHA-256 before accepting a live process.
The observer never signals, reparents, renices, changes affinity, migrates cgroups, opens writable descriptors to, or otherwise controls either adopted process.
Before both adopted process identities are absent, the observer reads only process metadata, file metadata, the already-existing guard JSON, frozen small inputs, and the fixed 16-byte trace header.
No gain, arm, control margin, chronological partition, or verdict is read or derived by this experiment.
The source-v1 result namespace is never written, renamed, linked, truncated, deleted, or completed by this observer.
The pretrace build, both manifests, and both scans remain byte-identical to the hashes frozen before adoption.
Terminal success requires exact CMX21P1 magic, 5,182,388,736 rows, 10,364,777,488 bytes, a nonempty stable parent archive, and three stable terminal file-stat samples.
The original monitoring gap is permanent: continuousResourceProofPass is false by construction and no resource qualification can be inferred from forward samples.
A recovery pass authorizes only a separately frozen immutable-trace analyzer; it grants no HORIZON scientific pass, native integration, archive saving, package score, or Hutter credit.
